commission_notes: Standard STP: no separate commission; trading cost is in the spread. per-side commission fields for ECN types are alternatives only. RT spread cost = (spread_pts + 2*slippage_points)*point_size*CONTRACT_SIZE*lots; RT commission = 2*commission_per_lot*lots when commission_per_lot>0.

cost_label_notes: Do not call this fully live-matched: slip=0 unmeasured, swap unmodeled. Spread+commission match Standard STP on this login.
